title: kampodra.json
description: kampodra repo manifest: project naming only. Committed per-project, discovered upward (nearest file wins), parsed strictly — unknown keys fail closed. Hosts, ssh keys, and secret material never belong here (those live in ~/.kampodra profiles, 0600).

$schema.description: Point at this schema file for editor autocomplete/validation. Accepted and ignored by kampodra itself.

container.description: The app container/service name (deploy target, restart, logs, kamal-proxy target).

pairInstancePrefix.description: Blue/green pair instance display-name prefix. Empty = derive from container (<container>-blue/<container>-green). Set it when the estate's existing instances predate container-derived naming (e.g. esellar-green while container is esellar-api) so status/provision/flip/rollback resolve the running sibling instead of seeing the pair as not-provisioned.

images.description: Secondary (sidecar) images deploy builds+streams+tags alongside the primary app image — no manual podman build/save/load.

sidecars.description: Declared sidecar images. Each builds from its repo-relative dockerfile, streams over the deploy's ssh, and lands on the VM as <imagePrefix>-<name>:latest.

name.description: Sidecar name — the image ref derives as <imagePrefix>-<name> (lowercase alnum, dash, underscore).

dockerfile.description: Repo-relative Dockerfile/Containerfile to build the sidecar from.

shadowSuffix.description: Suffix for the rolling deploy's shadow container.

envFile.description: Remote env file path on the VM (0600).

dataDir.description: Tenant/app data dir on the VM.

healthPath.description: App health endpoint behind the proxy (health gate).

services.description: Service roll call for init-aware stop/start/status.

imagePrefix.description: VM-local image ref the deploy pipeline tags (sha/latest).

port.description: The container's published/listening port (health gate + proxy target).

shadowProbePort.description: Rolling deploy's shadow container probe port.

deployedShaFile.description: Deployed-sha stamp file on the VM (rollback resolution + status).

envClearKeys.description: Env keys cleared from the service unit env.

migrateScript.description: Repo-relative path of the app's db migrate script (migrate runs it on the VM).

binary.description: Deploy --binary artifacts, keyed by name (a repo ships one per stack — e.g. the Go api AND the TS api during a cutover). `deploy --binary <name>` fast-pushes one: local build → atomic remote swap → restart → the same identity gates. The app unit bind-mounts each declared dir and execs the block's entry; vm-prepare --binary pins which one a VM serves. Code-only: dependency changes redeploy the image.

kind.description: go/rust: a single native executable (local cross-build, file swap, direct exec). node: a source tree run through a runtime (tsx/node): tar the tree, swap the dir, exec <exec> <dir>/<entry>.

dir.description: Absolute VM dir bind-mounted into the container (host path == in-container path). Staging and the run path share this filesystem so the swap mv is atomic.

target.description: go: the package (./cmd/server). rust: the bin name. node: unused (source-run).

artifact.description: Artifact path under buildDir after the build. go: must be empty (the build writes staging). rust: default <triple>/release/<target>. node: the source dir under buildDir (empty = buildDir itself).

entry.description: The file the container execs under dir: go/rust the binary's name, node the entry script (e.g. src/serve-node.ts).

exec.description: node only, required: the runtime (tsx or node) the unit prefixes the entry with. go/rust must leave it empty (the artifact IS the executable).

imagePath.description: Absolute path of the artifact INSIDE the image — image deploys mirror it into the mount so the unit's override serves the deployed version.

depsPath.description: node only, required: the in-image node_modules the mount symlinks at — the mount never carries dependencies (the image is the dep snapshot).

depsManifest.description: node only: repo-relative dep-manifest files hashed for drift detection (default: <buildDir>/package.json + root pnpm-lock.yaml). A code push whose hash differs from the image-stamped marker refuses.

triple.description: rust: cargo target triple (default aarch64-unknown-linux-musl — the golden images are musl-based).
